about: The official Python kit for MCP, a shared standard that lets AI assistants use outside tools and data.

prs.title: Code editors can now check tool handlers properly
prs.broken: The part of the kit that answers tool requests didn't say what it hands to a developer's code, so code editors couldn't warn about mistakes there.
prs.changed: I spelled out that it passes the tool's name and its inputs, a one-line change.
prs.matters: Small fix: code checkers can now catch wrongly written tool handlers before they run.
